title: Sticky-context middleware + deterministic sampling across async fences
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Add a middleware + SDK hook that preserves a minimal "sticky" request context (trace id, sampling seed, route attributes) across asynchronous boundaries and worker handoffs so sampling decisions are reproducible and trace attribution is stable. This reduces noisy partial traces when requests are re-enqueued or executed in detached fibers/workers and enables deterministic client-side sampling for lower telemetry cost while preserving the ability to force-sample via headers.
comments: 2026-03-10 - Aisha Patel: Drafted spec and sketched SDK hooks for Node/Python. Focus is a compact token (trace_id + seed + attr bitmap) that travels in both headers and an in-memory envelope for fast paths.

2026-03-11 - Marcus Chen: Prototyped Node middleware; verified that deterministic sampling using a xor-shift seed produces identical decisions after an async boundary when the seed is carried. Measured 0.7% p50 overhead on hot path.

2026-03-12 - Design review (Priya Rao): Recommend exposing opt-in API for apps to mark attributes as privacy-sensitive so they are not included in sticky payload. Also proposed UX for Console to toggle forced sampling per-route.
2026-03-13 - Marcus Chen: Implemented fallback fingerprinting when upstream header is missing. Added short-lived KV lease for cross-worker handoff (TTL 10s) to avoid synchronous DB calls.

2026-03-14 - QA (Diego Morales): Found edge case with long-lived batch workers: when worker reuses context for different incoming requests, we must clear sticky payload on deque. Added unit tests and a deterministic-run integration test harness.

2026-03-14 - Marcus Chen: Opened PR #1298 with middleware and SDK adapters for: express/fastify, aiohttp, python asyncio. Requesting reviews from SRE and Security. Perf bench results attached in the PR.

2026-03-14 - SRE (Amira Singh): Concern: KV lease introduces small external dependency; request a fallback no-KV mode for single-region Dedicated customers. Added dependency ENG-85670 to track Dedicated policy.

2026-03-14 - PM (Lena Fischer): Tie this rollout to telemetry-2026.03 and create a canary route for 10% of production traffic. Need dashboard panels for sampling ratio drift and unique-trace-count vs token-cost.
